image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a custom chrome alloy car wheel mounted on a red vehicle. The wheel features large, stylized spokes with a highly reflective chrome finish that mirrors the surroundings (including yellow lights and blue floor). A black rubber tire surrounds the rim. The red car body is visible in the background with some text decals ('Ranger' or similar) near the wheel well. The lighting is dramatic with strong highlights and lens flare effects.
